name: OrendaBox Hotspot
description: Start a WiFi hotspot on your OrendaBox so nearby devices can open Box-hosted web apps over the local HTTPS Orenda Home portal, even without internet access. Choose its WiFi name and password, optionally share internet, and set it to start after reboot. The Box safely releases a WiFi uplink only when Ethernet or mobile data has an active default route. Management stays behind Edge Console sign-in.
